title: PCR Clean-Up for Illumina 16S
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload custom labware definition, if needed.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather equipment and reagents
steps.instruction: Collect an Opentrons OT‑2 robot, Magnetic Module, GEN2 P300 and P20 8‑Channel Pipettes, Illumina 16S kit, AMPure XP beads, 80 % ethanol, 10 mM Tris pH 8.5 (or molecular‑grade water), appropriate tip racks, and a PCR plate.

steps.title: Prepare protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file, upload a custom labware definition if required, and then upload the protocol into the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing the magnetic module, tip racks, reagent reservoirs, and the PCR plate in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and both pipettes in the OT‑2 App using the calibration routine.

steps.title: Add AMPure XP beads
steps.instruction: Dispense 20 µL of AMPure XP beads into each well that already contains the user‑specified starting sample volume.

steps.title: Incubate for bead binding
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate on the Magnetic Module for the time recommended by the Illumina 16S kit to allow DNA binding to the beads.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the supernatant from each well after the incubation.

substeps.instruction: Add 195 µL of ethanol to each well.
Aspirate and discard the ethanol wash.
Repeat the wash a second time.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL of 10 mM Tris pH 8.5 (or molecular‑grade water) to each well and incubate for the time specified by the kit.

steps.title: Transfer eluate
steps.instruction: Aspirate 25 µL of the supernatant from each well and dispense it into a clean PCR plate.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, press “Run” to execute the automated PCR clean‑up sequence.
